note: Closed-loop repeats after the fixture-seed fix, run four times in a fixed order: the config that succeeded and the config that failed in the 2026-11-05 seed matrix, each twice, with the SAME scene seed and the SAME policy_seed inside a pair. The point is not a success rate: the two rounds of a pair are compared stage by stage (fixtures -> movable -> joints -> robot -> images -> policy input -> noise -> action0 -> action stream). The scene seed is unchanged from the matrix (5 and 3) but the fixture placement protocol changed, so the physics scene for a seed is NOT the same scene as the matrix ran: any change in outcome is reported as such, never as a retry.
